evidence_kind: static manifest declarations from original declared-target APK fixture

warnings.scope: The receipt reports 146 META-INF entry protection warnings covering license files, library version metadata, service descriptors and other metadata, plus four Java native-access warning lines. v1, v2 and v3 verification succeeded. This records scheme verification and signer identity, not a warning-free or generally safe artifact.

package_visibility.limitation: Visibility declarations describe packages and intent handlers that may be discoverable, not observed enumeration or uploaded inventory.

limitations: Manifest declarations do not establish executed code, granted permissions, transmitted data, exploitability, or a security vulnerability.
Exported counts include only literal android:exported=true declarations. Missing attributes remain separate; no reachability is inferred from counts alone.
No component permission attribute is not proof of unauthenticated behavior. Platform rules, enabled state, URI grants, calling-UID checks and runtime code can add restrictions.
SDK-family component names and metadata keys are static leads, not proof that an SDK initialized or sent a request.

Metadata values are omitted. Embedded Google OAuth client identifiers, Kakao application identifiers and Facebook application identifiers in intent schemes or provider authorities are redacted. No device, account or network-session content is included.
The network and backup XML resources were decoded without decompiling executable code. Runtime policy enforcement, provider caller checks and backup-agent behavior remain unreviewed.

network_security_policy.debug_overrides_limit: Android applies debug overrides only when android:debuggable is true; that attribute is absent in this manifest and defaults false.
network_security_policy.interpretation: A declared policy for clients that honor Android Network Security Configuration. The base system trust anchor explicitly sets overridePins=true, and this XML has no pin-set. This does not prove cleartext transfer, universal client enforcement, or absence of separate code-level pinning.

backup_policy_resource.interpretation: The referenced legacy full-backup-content XML contains this single include. Actual cloud backup and device transfer depend on OS policy, settings and unreviewed custom backup-agent behavior; no successful backup or exposed file is established.
